lessons.L1: CASH is not a symbol; excluded from turnover, concentration, drop-one
lessons.L2: execution cost charged exactly once per fill; no sidecar repetition
lessons.L3: one named turnover convention: sum(abs(delta_weight)) non-CASH (ADJ-5)
lessons.L4: canonical digest hashes exact artifact bytes, never a wrapper (A7T-B1)
lessons.L5: observed increments once when a score exists; replay increments neither; A1 alone appends the canonical ledger
lessons.L6: SPY/sector beta is not alpha; raw PnL never overrides failed incremental alpha or a firing control
lessons.L7: a control that is rank-identical (or near-identical) to its anchor cannot identify anything - measure control-anchor collinearity BEFORE selection (V4 lesson: A4-H2/A5-H2/A6-H1 self-subsuming controls)
lessons.L8: one cycle = one A1 thread; verify no cycle branch exists before dispatch - on 2026-09-04 two concurrent controller sessions interleaved commits on STOCKS-FREE-V5 (e4e8a55 vs b16e3dd/a264e5e) and one unilaterally quarantined the other's work; owner adjudication overturned the quarantine and made pit_conditioning.py canonical. Dispatch protocol: before starting a cycle controller, check git branch -a and git worktree list for existing cycle branches/worktrees and refuse to start if any exist.
lessons.L9: publish cell artifacts through one committed, convention-pinned publisher: the V5 ad-hoc Phase-E publisher used a ledger artifact_digest convention that is not recomputable from committed cells (V4 convention: sha256 of compact canonical JSON); counters/once-only/file-SHA chain were independently verified, but recompute-convention continuity broke (A7T F-A7T-1 MEDIUM, record-only)

fusion_lessons.registry_discipline: no fusion source is authorized by registration, parser tests, or HTTP 200; authorization is an explicit owner-side disposition per source
fusion_lessons.availability_semantics: true availability = filing timestamps (SEC) or ALFRED vintage dates; retrieval time never substitutes

v7_bindings_from_owner_plan_and_dispatch.B1_PROBE_FIRST_TERMINAL: P0b-2 is the first decision and is CHEAP AND TERMINAL: gates 1-6 in order; any failure closes STOCKS_FREE_V7_BLOCKED_DATA_AUTHORITY with evidence within hours - a successful run, not a defeat; no degraded panel is ever scored
v7_bindings_from_owner_plan_and_dispatch.B2_KEY_ENV_ONLY: existing API key lives in the environment only - never in prompts, logs, JSON artifacts or git (handbook s27); no new signup, key or purchase; an owner-provided source goes through the same gates
v7_bindings_from_owner_plan_and_dispatch.B3_COHORT_PARALLEL: P0c cohort lane runs in parallel from SEC submissions status history; census published before D1 and reconciled against the price probe's servable set
v7_bindings_from_owner_plan_and_dispatch.B4_CONCURRENCY: pwd before every git worktree add; one cycle = one A1 thread (verified no v7 branch existed); full pytest alone; foreign cycles respected - record NOT_RUN_RESOURCE_CONFLICT rather than contending for heavy slots
v7_bindings_from_owner_plan_and_dispatch.B5_GO_EXTINGUISHED: the V6 standing GO is EXTINGUISHED (Lead ruling, ledger 7720ee3): V7 needs its own owner GO; HARD STOP before the first scored cell until the owner types 'GO STOCKS V7 SCORED EXECUTION'
